claim_text: There will not be a civil war in the nation and it will not be red against blue, with revival called from the Gulf to Canada and a shaking in the governments of Canada, Mexico, Cuba, Venezuela, Colombia and Brazil.
quote: We will not have a civil war in this nation
falsify_match: No American civil conflict, alongside upheaval in those governments.
falsify_miss: Civil conflict breaks out. He declares against it here while describing it elsewhere.

claim_text: The frog is jumping around and looking around under a light shining like a headlight, and it is connected to Kentucky.
quote: the frog is connected to the Kentucky
falsify_match: A corruption case centred on Kentucky.
falsify_miss: None. No person or office is named, only the state.

claim_text: The frog is related to Kentucky and he sees corruption there, then Minnesota, Pennsylvania and Boston, with Los Angeles too close and the source named.
quote: I see corruption. I see Minnesota. I see uh I see Pennsylvania
falsify_match: Corruption cases in those states.
falsify_miss: None. Naming five states and cities makes a partial hit likely somewhere.

claim_text: Very rich billionaires are involved in the days ahead, with Asia, America and Europe seen and certain parts of the world wanting to do their own thing, and a table of businessmen and bankers discussing it as he looks at the Clarity Act.
quote: Certain billionaires who are very very very rich are involved in this
falsify_match: Rival regional crypto frameworks set up against the American one.
falsify_miss: None. He says himself he does not know when and is assuming the timing.

claim_text: Asia will not allow America to be the crypto capital of the world and will come against it with its own arrangement, as will the Middle Eastern countries, all leading to the same pot, differing on which currencies they back.
quote: America wants to be the the crypto capital of the world
falsify_match: Asian and Gulf blocs formalising rival digital currency arrangements.
falsify_miss: They do not. Both regions already had their own regimes in place when this was said.

claim_text: He was given a window to hold the president in prayer for decisions that give America a shallow way through, seen as a wave that was not vast, ridden on a surfboard with gold and dollar signs on it.
quote: It was a wave that Trump was riding on with a surfboard
falsify_match: A shallow rather than severe downturn.
falsify_miss: A severe one. Shallow is not defined against any measure.

claim_text: He was told one per cent, meaning one per cent of the world's population will take part in the wealth transfer, which is still a lot of people, because not everybody will hear him.
quote: He said 1%. So 1% of the world's population
falsify_match: Nothing measurable. There is no register of who took part.
falsify_miss: Nothing measurable. Not everybody will hear him means any shortfall is explained.

claim_text: He plays a broadcast clip of a legislator saying Republicans and Democrats now agree on language for the crypto legislation, the White House agrees, and one step remains which is industry agreement.
quote: We have one more step to go
falsify_match: Not his claim. A recording he plays.
falsify_miss: Not his claim. Recorded so the clip is not counted as a word.

claim_text: Three named banks hold a rope on a rocket and pull it down, with crypto bouncing in white water rapids in front of them, until a meeting where one man makes everything work, they shake hands and the stream calms.
quote: I saw the three big banks, Chase, Wells Fargo, and Bank of America
falsify_match: Those banks dropping their opposition and crypto prices rising sharply.
falsify_miss: They keep opposing. He has told this with four banks and a lasso elsewhere, so the count moves.

claim_text: A mass power event or a McVeigh-style bombing aimed at infrastructure, with substations across major American cities taken out, nuclear facilities targeted, and a dump truck of fertiliser at the Hoover Dam to flood Nevada.
quote: I saw Hoover Dam with a massive dump truck
falsify_match: An attempted attack on the Hoover Dam or a coordinated substation attack.
falsify_miss: Neither. He reasons out loud about how much it would take, which is his own working rather than the vision.

claim_text: A major disruption on the bridge from New Jersey into Manhattan, split in the middle with cars going off the side into the water, alongside attacks on the vehicles around the president and a list of targets from least to greatest.
quote: it was split in the middle and cars were going off the side
falsify_match: A structural attack on one of the Hudson crossings.
falsify_miss: None. Only a handful carry road traffic into Manhattan, which keeps the target list short enough to check.

claim_text: Highly trained men comparable to Navy SEALs came in from Canada across the northern border rather than the southern one, because too many people were watching the south.
quote: They came from Canada. How they got here? I don't know
falsify_match: Operatives arrested after entering across the northern border.
falsify_miss: None. He says himself he does not know how they got here.

claim_text: The same kind of thing is set up in Chicago, Seattle and other cities across America, not just New York, at other major substations, and the Lord says it is much bigger than they realise.
quote: As I saw key things in Chicago, Seattle, and other cities
falsify_match: Devices or plots found at substations in those cities.
falsify_miss: None found. He is building on an article he has already shown.

claim_text: A multi tens of million dollar operation funded by Iran and terrorist organisations has been running for a while, aimed at the power grid and social unrest, with strategic targets in the summer months and the 250th anniversary celebration.
quote: funded by Iran and by uh uh terrorist organizations
falsify_match: A disclosed Iranian-funded network aimed at American infrastructure.
falsify_miss: None disclosed. The summer months and the anniversary give a window that closes in 2026.

claim_text: It is not a punch for a punch but a fatal blow they want, to keep America out of what they intend to do with Israel, which is why America is absent from Ezekiel 38, being busy with what is going on inside the nation.
quote: they want to do a fatal blow to keep America out
falsify_match: An attack on America that removes it from a Middle East conflict.
falsify_miss: None. The Ezekiel reasoning is an interpretation supplied to fill a gap in the text.

claim_text: America will remain a sheep nation, but will be shaken to awaken it for haughtiness, and a darkness settles in with a new type of Obama spokesman who he wonders may profess to be Republican.
quote: I'm going to shake America for they for they are they're spoiled brats
falsify_match: A national reversal alongside the rise of such a figure.
falsify_miss: Neither. Nobody is named, and shaking to awaken has no threshold.

claim_text: A dark agenda in which America is completely changed, almost a complete rewriting of the Constitution, with a dark umbrella coming over the nation, and a few determined people will not stop it.
quote: almost like a completely rewriting of the Constitution
falsify_match: A constitutional convention or wholesale amendment process.
falsify_miss: None. Almost like a rewriting leaves the threshold open.

claim_text: Californians think differently from the heartland, and the Bible Belt cannot speak for all of America, which is only a sliver of red.
quote: we can't take the heartland of the Bible Belt
falsify_match: Nothing. Commentary.
falsify_miss: Nothing. No event is named.

claim_text: A shaking coming to Europe, with an 8.2 hitting just outside Rome that is devastating, houses like pillars of rubble and complete devastation at the epicentre.
quote: I saw again an 8.2 hitting Rome that was devastating
falsify_match: An earthquake of about that size near Rome.
falsify_miss: None. Italy has never recorded above about 7.4 and its faults cannot produce an 8.2.

claim_text: He says he gave a sugarcoated version tonight and will never give the great detail of what he saw because it would be foolish, and that the audience has enough.
quote: I'm never going to give the great detail of what I saw
falsify_match: Nothing. A statement about what he withholds.
falsify_miss: Nothing. Recorded because it is the standing reason the sharpest material is never on the record.

claim_text: He had an urgency and was shown more about praying over the Clarity Act specifically, not the Save America Act, alongside a sophisticated device found in an apartment complex.
quote: praying over the Clarity Act, not the Save America Act
falsify_match: The Clarity Act passing or failing on a knife edge.
falsify_miss: Neither. Praying over a bill is not a prediction about it.

claim_text: A prayer over the crude and gas pipelines and against every plot on the economy, naming Homeland Security, the FBI and the NSA over cyber attacks on the electric grid.
quote: whoever is over any kind of cyber attacks over our electric grid
falsify_match: A successful cyber attack on the American grid.
falsify_miss: None. The prayer framing means an absence is read as an answer.

claim_text: A prayer over the grids, water plants, dams, New York skyscrapers, mass transit and subways, and over the list of people he saw, naming two broadcasters, the attorney general and five of the president's children.
quote: We pray over the list that I saw over every plot
falsify_match: An attempt on one of the named people.
falsify_miss: None. The names are the most prominent figures on that side of American politics, which is where the list would come from anyway.

claim_text: A prayer that China will leave Taiwan alone and not take the chips, that all the chips will be protected, and that Japan, South Korea and the other Asian nations will rise up, with the Secretary of State given wisdom over liberating Cuba.
quote: that China will leave Taiwan alone. That they'll not take the chips
falsify_match: Taiwan and its semiconductor industry stay out of Chinese hands.
falsify_miss: China takes them. He prays against the outcome he elsewhere says is coming.

claim_text: The Lord is raising up men and women across the United States, South Korea and North Korea, with big revivals coming in North Korea, China, the Philippines, Japan, Canada and Europe, and the biggest harvest to look back on.
quote: We're going to have a big revival in North Korea
falsify_match: Documented mass conversions in those countries.
falsify_miss: None. North Korea would be the clean test, since nothing there could be missed if it happened.

claim_text: Lights appear all over the map like little stars from a satellite photo, all over Cuba, starting on the northeast side of the island and glowing across it.
quote: they looked like little stars. And they started to appear all over the map
falsify_match: Nothing observable on its own.
falsify_miss: Nothing observable. The northeast starting point does not match the west, middle and east wells he gave a week later.

claim_text: Noting that the vice president is being sent to Pakistan for a meeting, he prays for peace but says there is something more to push, and that the liberation of Cuba will be quick for the Cuban people.
quote: it will be quickly for the Cuban people
falsify_match: A rapid change of government in Cuba.
falsify_miss: A slow one, or none. Quickly is not given a length.

claim_text: He says visions are not always about America, that America is only three hundred and some million people and the work is global, and points to what a named asset manager said that day.
quote: It's not always America, folks. We're called to the globe
falsify_match: Nothing on its own.
falsify_miss: Nothing. It widens where any image can be placed, which makes the geography claims harder to fail.

claim_text: A graph of the dollar and the stock market from 1929 to now looks almost cookie-cutter identical, which he thought could not be real.
quote: from 1929 to now it almost looks like they're friends
falsify_match: A crash on the 1929 pattern.
falsify_miss: No crash. He says himself he doubted the chart was real.

claim_text: The dollar has to be destroyed first, the deficit is almost fifty trillion and impossible to pay back in the natural, and the president is paddling a canoe to keep it from going over Niagara Falls but it will eventually go over.
quote: it's just buying time. It's treading water
falsify_match: A dollar collapse or default.
falsify_miss: None. The published federal debt was about thirty eight trillion when he said fifty.

claim_text: He recalls warning of lines and certain medicines being unavailable, and cites a viewer email saying half of American medicines come from India.
quote: I saw that you couldn't get medicines. There were certain medicines
falsify_match: Shortages of specific drug classes traced to Asian supply.
falsify_miss: No shortage. The supply figures come from a viewer email he has not checked.

claim_text: While people are distracted with Iran, China takes Taiwan within a three day window in the still of the night, blacking it out with cyber warfare, with little fight, because they wanted the chips, as Japan moves to the strait to help defend it.
quote: they took over Taiwan within a 3-day window
falsify_match: China takes Taiwan in about three days using cyber means first.
falsify_miss: It does not, or a long conflict follows. He has given this bound as two days elsewhere.

claim_text: North Korea and Russia had a plan alongside it, trade wars follow with medicine used as blackmail against America, Japan sticks by America's side, and a mother hen tries to scoop the Asian nations from South Korea onward toward China.
quote: I saw Japan stuck by our side
falsify_match: Japan stays aligned with America while other Asian states move toward China.
falsify_miss: Japan flips. Japan has been a treaty ally since 1960, so staying is the base case.

claim_text: He says he saw China in the meetings, three men in white lab coats who were frantic and not optimistic as the Americans were.
quote: I actually could see three different men who were talking about this
falsify_match: Chinese and American impact assessments diverging publicly.
falsify_miss: They do not diverge. He attaches this to a same-day news item found by his son.

claim_text: The Americans in the meeting said the maths is in their favour and it will pass by while the Chinese said it will certainly hit, and wormwood will be a major event that boils the water and kills all the fish in the sea.
quote: It will boil the water. It will It will kill all the fish
falsify_match: An ocean impact with mass marine death.
falsify_miss: No impact. He gives no date here, and elsewhere places it in 2029.

claim_text: A covering called over church services worldwide including the Vatican, that there will be no mass casualties of any kind at gatherings.
quote: there will be no mass casualties of any kind
falsify_match: No mass casualty attack at a church over the period.
falsify_miss: One occurs. Stated as a covering rather than a forecast, which makes either outcome usable.

claim_text: Glossy white pipes and containers for oil or gas in America, running like plumbing, with sabotage on another oil facility.
quote: I see sabotage again on another oil facility
falsify_match: A sabotage incident at an American gas or oil plant painted white.
falsify_miss: None. He says himself he cannot tell whether it is oil or natural gas.

claim_text: It would shut down the banks in major cities, with New York completely dark and the lights off at a named bank's building.
quote: I see New York a completely dark. Completely dark
falsify_match: A citywide New York blackout that closes banks.
falsify_miss: None. The last citywide New York blackout was in 1977.

claim_text: In a burst of fragmentary speech he sees cars, a book on a bridge, the road and the motorcade in New York.
quote: I SEE the the motorcade
falsify_match: An attack on a motorcade at a New York bridge.
falsify_miss: None. The passage is fragmentary and yields little beyond the two images.

claim_text: Attacks on the motorcades, with a hit list held by Middle Eastern men described as Iranian special operations, ordered from less to more importance, of people to eliminate out of the government in return for their own.
quote: I saw a hit list and there they looked like Middle Eastern men
falsify_match: A disclosed Iranian plot to kill named American officials.
falsify_miss: None disclosed. Iranian plots against former officials have been charged before, which sets the base rate.

claim_text: Looking into Italy after a blackout in the skies he sees a major earthquake again, an 8.2 close to Rome, with 8.2 specifically the number he saw.
quote: Italy will have an 8.2 earthquake close to Rome
falsify_match: An 8.2 near Rome.
falsify_miss: None. The number is stated three times across three broadcasts, which makes it the firmest figure in this material and the easiest to fail.

claim_text: A charismatic forked tongue figure is coming who will sway even believers, like Obama, playing on race and on the Spanish-speaking vote, with the New York result offered as the pattern.
quote: a charismatic forked tongue person is coming
falsify_match: A charismatic national figure rising on that appeal.
falsify_miss: None. Nobody is named, which is what keeps it from being scoreable.

claim_text: A major revival happens in the central part of America along the I-35 corridor, which the enemy knows is prophesied and works against with liberal thinking, as around Tulsa.
quote: I-35 corridor. A major revival will happen in the central part
falsify_match: Documented church growth along that corridor.
falsify_miss: None. Opposition being expected means slow progress is anticipated rather than counted against it.

claim_text: America will not be a goat nation but will remain a sheep nation, with Jesus proclaimed Lord over a list of named states.
quote: America will not be a goat nation. We will remain a sheep nation
falsify_match: Nothing measurable. The sheep and goat division is a judgment claim.
falsify_miss: Nothing measurable. He states it as a declaration rather than a word.

claim_text: The bluer the state the greater the revival and the greater the harvest, with Minnesota, Michigan, New York, Pennsylvania, Ontario, British Columbia, England, Ireland and the Koreas named.
quote: The bluer the bluer they are, the greater revival
falsify_match: Church growth concentrated in the most secular places named.
falsify_miss: Growth stays where it is. The rule means the least likely places are also where he expects the most.
